forge.menu.updatescreen.title: Mod update
forge.configgui.removeErroringEntities.t: When true, entities that throw errors during updates will be removed instead of shutting down the server and reporting the crash log. Warning: This may have serious consequences. Please use it with caution, we will not be responsible for any losses.
forge.configgui.removeErroringBlockEntit: Setting this to true will remove block entities that throw an error when updating, rather than shutting down the server and reporting a crash log. Warning: This may have serious consequences. Please use it with caution, we will not be responsible for any losses.
forge.configgui.fullBoundingBoxLadders.t: When true, this will detect whether the entire entity has touched the ladder, rather than the block in which they are located. This resulted in significant mechanics recognition differences, so the default is the vanilla Minecraft behavior. Default: false
forge.configgui.zombieBaseSummonChance.t: The base spawn probability of zombie summons. Changing this changes the mechanism by which additional zombies are spawned.
forge.configgui.zombieBabyChance.tooltip: The probability of baby zombies appearing among all zombies (including subtypes of zombies). Changing this changes the zombie spawning mechanism.
forge.configgui.logCascadingWorldGenerat: Logging terrain filling issues when generating cascading chunks.
forge.configgui.fixVanillaCascading.tool: Fixed issues with original layered world generation. This will change how the vanilla world generator works, please do not report any inconsistencies with the vanilla world generation.
forge.configgui.fixVanillaCascading: Fixed original layered world generation problem
forge.configgui.dimensionUnloadQueueDela: The time in ticks that the server waits before unloading a dimension. Adjusting this option appropriately can be helpful in situations where dimensions are loading or unloading quickly (such as dropping items into the Nether Portal at a certain frequency, forcing it to stay loaded).
forge.configgui.clumpingThreshold.toolti: Adjust the critical value for Packet51 to be better than Packet52. The default minimum is 64 and the maximum is 1024.
forge.configgui.treatEmptyTagsAsAir.tool: Vanilla will use the empty tag processing recipe and will not allow you to craft anything in that slot. If this option is false, empty tags in this change will use the barrier as the item. The purpose is to prevent the use of air synthesis.
forge.configgui.forceSystemNanoTime.tool: Force the use of System.nanoTime instead of glfwGetTime as the primary client time provider.
forge.configgui.zoomInMissingModelTextIn: Turning this off will cause the GUI's missing model text to fit into the field.
Zoom in on model missing text in GUI
forge.configgui.forgeCloudsEnabled.toolt: Handle cloud rendering to the GPU for faster rendering speeds.
Disables culling of hidden faces next to stairs and steps. This will cause extra rendering, but may fix some resource packs that take advantage of this vanilla mechanic.
forge.configgui.alwaysSetupTerrainOffThr:
When enabled, Forge will distribute all block updates to independent block update threads.
It may significantly increase FPS, but it may also cause strange rendering lags.
Enabling this option is not recommended on computers with few available cores.
forge.configgui.forgeLightPipelineEnable: Enable Forge block rendering pipeline - Fixed lighting issues with custom models.
forge.configgui.selectiveResourceReloadE: When enabled, certain heavy-duty tasks (such as switching languages) will occur faster.
forge.configgui.showLoadWarnings.tooltip: When enabled, Forge will display any warnings that occur during loading.
forge.configgui.disableVersionCheck.tool: When this option is true, the Forge version detection mechanism will be disabled. Forge will compare and query a smaller json file on our server to obtain version information. See the ForgeVersion class on GitHub for more details.
